title: Maekon managed.json (MDM policy overlay)
description: Enterprise MDM policy overlay for the Maekon desktop client (E20-40 #4832; schema published in E20-45 #4837). Deploy this file read-only to the system-wide, admin-writable managed-config location; any field present LOCKS the corresponding AppConfig path (the local user cannot override it). The struct in crates/maekon-core/src/config/managed.rs IS the lockable allowlist — only the fields below can be locked. Unknown extra keys are tolerated (forward-compat: a file authored for a newer schema_version must not brick an older client), which is why every object permits additionalProperties; a schema_version newer than the client supports is rejected fail-closed at load. A present-but-malformed file (bad type / bad enum token) is also fail-closed (the app refuses to start unmanaged). This schema mirrors that runtime contract: known fields are strictly typed and enum-constrained; unknown keys pass.

schema_version.description: managed.json schema version. The current client supports version 2 (ManagedConfig::SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION). A file authored for a newer version is rejected fail-closed; version 1 files remain readable for migration compatibility.

pii_filter_level.description: Locks privacy.pii_filter_level. Higher levels mask more PII on-device before any upload.

min_pii_filter_level.description: Enforces a minimum privacy.pii_filter_level floor without lowering a stricter user value.

enabled.description: Locks telemetry.enabled. Locking false hard-disables OTLP telemetry egress fleet-wide.

capture_enabled.description: Locks vision.capture_enabled. Locking false hard-disables screen capture fleet-wide.

cloud_stt_policy.description: Locks audio.cloud_stt_policy — the fleet gate for cloud speech-to-text raw-audio egress, independent of whether any individual user enters an API key. 'disabled' means raw audio never leaves the device.

enabled.description: Locks update.enabled. Locking false is an immediate fleet update kill-switch: the update loop never spawns and the coordinator stays Idle.

min_allowed_version.description: Locks update.min_allowed_version (semver). Pins the oldest release the auto-updater may install — a downgrade/rollback guard below a security baseline. A release below this floor is rejected (#4836).

max_allowed_version.description: Locks update.max_allowed_version (semver). Freezes the fleet at/below a known-good version — a soft update kill-switch that, unlike enabled=false, still permits updates up to the cap. A release above this ceiling is held (reported up-to-date), not installed (#4836). Must be >= min_allowed_version when both are set.

features.description: Runtime-enforced feature pins that can disable high-risk surfaces or allow them only when local user consent and runtime gates still permit them. Managed policy cannot turn a feature on by itself. Reserved pins for browser_verification, record_to_template, and remote_observe_approve are intentionally not published here until their runtime gates are wired; a client that recognizes one of those reserved fields rejects the bundle fail-closed instead of silently advertising an unenforced lock.

permission_profiles.description: Allowed or denied built-in permission-profile identifiers for reviewed automation bundles. The managed overlay clamps the legacy sandbox profile to the strictest allowed built-in profile when the current profile is denied.

allowed_profiles.description: Optional allowlist. Empty means user-controlled unless a denial also matches.

provider_surfaces.description: Provider surface allowlist. When enforced, remote OCR/LLM surfaces not listed here are forced back to local providers.

enforce.description: When true, enforce allowlist even when it is empty. A non-empty allowlist also enables enforcement.

allowlist.description: Canonical provider_surface.* identifiers allowed for remote OCR/LLM. Empty plus enforce=true is default-deny.

sandbox_network.description: Sandbox and network constraints that only narrow runtime authority. Local target or bind denial conservatively clamps the legacy sandbox network flag off because the legacy AppConfig cannot represent local-only submodes.

minimum_profile.description: Minimum sandbox strictness. Less restrictive user profiles are raised to this profile.

deny_local_targets.description: Denies local/private network targets in Permission Profile V2 policy evaluation.

deny_local_binding.description: Denies local bind/listen behavior in Permission Profile V2 policy evaluation.

export_required.description: Marks audit export as required for enterprise review surfaces.

signature.description: Optional signed bundle metadata. If require_signature=true and bundle_signature is absent, loading fails closed.

require_signature.description: Require bundle_signature to be present before the managed policy is accepted.

bundle_signature.description: Detached or embedded signature string for the policy bundle.

managedFeaturePin.description: Feature pin state. disabled hard-disables the feature; allowed_with_user_consent does not enable it and leaves local consent/runtime gates in force.
